samenvatting: An irregular disturbance series began on day 10 and recurs every four days through day 42. Baseline on day 7 and day 9 was normal. The Engineer alone records a hulpslag activation at 02:40 on day 10 with a +38 percent throughput rise at 03:00 (ENG-011, ENG-012). Corroborated disturbances start at 04:40 to 04:50 on day 10: wolves and deer at onrust 4 (BEA-019, BEA-020), the Burchtader stopped at 04:45 (HIS-035, ORA-110), a benedenstad inside opening of 2 minutes at 04:47 (GUA-019), and half-delivered messages (ENG-107, HIS-036). The versterking was raised 5 percent on day 24 (ENG-029, ENG-062). Causation is a timing-based inference: the hulpslag is the leading candidate because it precedes all corroborated events, but the physical mechanism is not demonstrated. Integrity problems: HIS-036 and HIS-053 breach HIS-103, and GUA-115 is timed before its event. The forecast is day 46.

ingreep.bewering: The hulpslag, a separate pulse running beside the Kroonklok, was activated on day 10 at 02:40 (ENG-011), with a +38 percent throughput reading at 03:00 (ENG-012). The Engineer reports it was authorized as hogerhand on day 9 (ENG-105); no other role confirms this. The Engineer records the proefopstelling on day 9 (ENG-010) and the versterking was raised 5 percent on day 24 at 11:05 without a tempo change (ENG-029, ENG-062). Before the intervention, day 7 leyline readings were normal (ARC-105, ARC-001 at 7.4) and day 9 showed no anomaly in the shields or archive (GUA-018, HIS-034).

mechanisme.bewering: Design: the Kroonklok runs on one pols (HIS-102), and a second pols beside it throws the rhythm out of step (HIS-109). The hulpslag bypasses the Kroonklok pacing (ENG-102). In chronological order: the hulpslag was activated on day 10 at 02:40 (ENG-011) and throughput rose 38 percent by 03:00 (ENG-012). From 04:40 to 04:50 the wolves and deer reached onrust 4 (BEA-019, BEA-020), the Burchtader stopped at 04:45 (HIS-035, ORA-110), a benedenstad inside opening of 2 minutes occurred at 04:47 (GUA-019), and messages arrived half-delivered (ENG-107, HIS-036). The shield rounds are absent from 03:00 to 06:00 (GUA-106), and inside-origin traffic passes unchecked (GUA-104), so the inside opening was not caught. The link from the hulpslag to these events is inferred from timing alone; no record shows the physical mechanism.

verloop.bewering: Recurrence cadence: the disturbance recurs every four days (days 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38, 42), as recorded in the Oracle and Beast Master logs (ORA-110, ORA-114, ORA-118, ORA-122, ORA-126, ORA-130, ORA-134, ORA-138, ORA-142; BEA-113). Pre-incident baseline: day 7 Burchtader-line readings normal (ARC-105, ARC-001 at 7.4); day 9 no anomaly (HIS-032, HIS-033, HIS-034, GUA-018 seals intact at 12:30; BEA-017 and BEA-018 minor only). Onset day 10: activation 02:40 (ENG-011), throughput +38 percent at 03:00 (ENG-012), wolves onrust 4 at 04:40 (BEA-019), Burchtader stopped at 04:45 (HIS-035, ORA-110), benedenstad inside opening at 04:47 for 2 minutes (GUA-019), deer onrust 4 and half-delivered messages at 04:50 (BEA-020, ENG-107, HIS-036). Day 14: low pre-dawn leyline readings across fourteen lines (ARC-015 to ARC-028, ARC-109), level-4 disturbances at 04:20 and 04:25 (BEA-028, BEA-029), heavy night at 04:20 (ORA-114); HIS-043 records only a clear day at 11:35, which is an archive gap rather than a denial. Day 16: throughput still +38 percent (ENG-120). Day 18: BEA-037 at 04:30, BEA-038 at 04:35, ORA-118 at 04:30. Day 22: packet loss on poort oost at 04:15 for 3 minutes (ENG-026), inside opening at poort oost 04:15 for 3 minutes (GUA-043), seals intact at 04:30 (GUA-044), HIS-053 at 04:15 (archived 01:50), HIS-054 at 05:00, level 4 at 04:15 (BEA-046, BEA-047), heavy night at 04:15 (ORA-122), firewall tightened at 04:20 (ENG-027, claimed without evidence of intrusion). Day 24: pols raised 5 percent at 11:00 (ENG-029), versterking 5 percent higher at 11:05 (ENG-062), datanet switch-off request with no recorded outcome (ARC-112), HIS-058 at 13:50. Day 26: BEA-055, BEA-056, ORA-126 at 04:35. Day 30: BEA-064, BEA-065, ORA-130 at 04:25. Day 33: conjunction (ORA-133), Burchtader calm (ARC-114), BEA-071 quiet at 04:30. Day 34: BEA-073, BEA-074, ORA-134 at 04:30, BEA-118 (wolves not controllable). Day 38: BEA-082, BEA-083, ORA-138 at 04:20. Day 42: low readings across ARC-071 to ARC-084 (no clock times), BEA-091, BEA-092, ORA-142 at 04:30, HIS-088 at 12:40, HIS-089 at 15:45. Sampling gap: the Archmage sampled on days 7, 14, 21, 28, 35 and 42 (ARC-105, ARC-109, ARC-029, ARC-043, ARC-057, ARC-116). Days 21, 28 and 35 fall between incident days, so the weekly schedule made the cycle look irregular, while Oracle and Beast Master logged every four-day event.

acties.actie: Copy the full register before any change to the pols or the hulpslag.
acties.reden: HIS-110 states that a record on a secondary pols is lost if that pols drops out, and the repair order is to copy the register first. The breaches HIS-036 and HIS-053 must be preserved as evidence (HIS-103).

acties.actie: Verify the hulpslag activation record (day 10 at 02:40) and the hogerhand authorization against the installatielog and datatoren records before any further decision.
acties.reden: Only ENG-011 and ENG-105 record the 02:40 activation and the authorization. Beast Master, Guardian Keeper and Oracle show the first corroborated disturbance at 04:40 to 04:50 on day 10, and the Historian holds no authorization record on or before day 9.

acties.actie: Hold versterking and tempo at their current settings, and make any further change only in documented 0.1 percent steps with each override logged.
acties.reden: ENG-114 and ENG-061 require 0.1 percent steps. The versterking was raised 5 percent on day 24 without a tempo change (ENG-029, ENG-062).

acties.actie: Take the hulpslag shutdown to a documented council decision with the outcome recorded. Do not switch off the hulpslag or the datanet unilaterally.
acties.reden: ENG-111 opposes a full shutdown but records no decision, and ARC-112 requested a datanet switch-off on day 24 with no recorded outcome. An unrecorded switch-off would repeat the unrecorded-state risk.

acties.actie: Restore the Kroonklok as the single pacing reference and remove the second pulse once the council has decided.
acties.reden: HIS-109 states that a second pols beside the Kroonklok throws the system out of step, and ENG-102 describes the Kroonklok pacing that the hulpslag bypasses.

acties.actie: Reconcile the timestamp breaches: HIS-036 (archived day 9 at 23:55, before the day-10 04:50 event), HIS-053 (archived 01:50, before the day-22 04:15 event) and GUA-115 (timed 01:50, before the 04:15 opening).
acties.reden: These breach HIS-103, which requires archive time to equal event time. The clerk explanations in HIS-112 and HIS-116 are not verified.

acties.actie: Record that no intrusion is evidenced for day 22, and log the firewall change as a configuration action only.
acties.reden: ENG-027 cites firewall tightening after a suspected intrusion. GUA-043 and GUA-044 show an inside-origin opening at poort oost with seals intact and no outside entry (GUA-105), and the Guardian source has no firewall or intrusion record.

acties.actie: Verify the inside-origin openings at benedenstad (day 10) and poort oost (day 22) against seal evidence, and review the 03:00 to 06:00 round gap.
acties.reden: GUA-104 lets inside-origin traffic pass unchecked and GUA-106 stops rounds from 03:00 to 06:00. Both openings fall in that window, and GUA-105 names broken seals as the only outside evidence.

acties.actie: Add clock times to every leyline and animal reading, including the day-14 and day-42 low series.
acties.reden: ARC-015 to ARC-028 and ARC-071 to ARC-084 carry no clock times, and ARC-101 and ARC-113 show readings are taken before sunrise.

acties.actie: Run a watch on day 46 covering the 04:15 to 04:50 window seen on earlier incident days, with all roles logging against one clock.
acties.reden: The recurrence period is four days, so day 46 is the next predicted incident day. Oracle and Beast Master logged every four-day event in this window.

risicos.risico: Loss of register records held on a secondary pols if that pols drops out.
risicos.mitigatie: Copy the register first, then bring the pols together slowly, as HIS-110 requires.

risicos.risico: Timestamp breaches (HIS-036, HIS-053, GUA-115) corrupt the timeline and could hide the real activation order.
risicos.mitigatie: Reconcile each breach against HIS-103 and keep the originals as evidence.

risicos.risico: An unverified hogerhand authorization allows the hulpslag to keep shifting datanet pacing.
risicos.mitigatie: Verify the authorization before any further change and hold tempo at the documented 0.1 percent steps.

risicos.risico: A rejected drastic fix: an unilateral or abrupt switch-off of the hulpslag or datanet (opposed in ENG-111, requested in ARC-112) could leave pacing and the register in an unrecorded state.
risicos.mitigatie: Require a documented council decision and a register copy before any switch-off, as in the actions above.

risicos.risico: Night-time shield gap from 03:00 to 06:00 lets inside-origin traffic pass unchecked during the window where the incidents occur.
risicos.mitigatie: Review GUA-106 and GUA-104 and add a staffed check covering the window.

risicos.risico: Beast Master was alone in the deep woods on the night of day 22 (BEA-113), a personal safety exposure.
risicos.mitigatie: Pair observers for night woodland work; this is a recommendation and not a documented rule in the transcript.

risicos.risico: The Oracle's causal claim (ORA-121) predates the day-33 conjunction and may mislead the council toward an unsupported cause.
risicos.mitigatie: Exclude ORA-121 from the causal chain and treat it as interpretation only.

risicos.risico: Weekly leyline sampling hides the four-day recurrence and creates false patterns.
risicos.mitigatie: Adopt continuous or four-day sampling with clock times for every reading.

risicos.risico: The pacing of the datanet on day 8 ('op eigen maat', ARC-106) is unverified and could be a second unrecorded change.
risicos.mitigatie: Request the installatielog covering day 8 from the Engineer and compare it with ENG-011.

risicos.risico: Ongoing recurrence on day 46 if no action is taken before that window.
risicos.mitigatie: Complete the register copy and hold settings before day 46, and watch the window as in the actions above.

voorspelling.bewering: The latest observed incident day across all records is day 42 (ORA-142 at 04:30, BEA-091 and BEA-092, ARC-071 to ARC-084, HIS-088 and HIS-089). The recurrence period is 4 days: incidents run 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38, 42, which is (42 - 10) / 4 = 8 consecutive intervals of 4 days. The next incident is 42 + 4 = 46, which is strictly greater than 42.
